title: Recoverability policy editing for closed-loop safety in autonomous driving
abstract: arXiv:2611.34403v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous driving powered by neural network models lacks safety guarantees. We propose a state-level policy editing technique that guarantees closed-loop safety under recoverable disturbances while reusing the model's existing driving capabilities. Closed-loop safety means that the vehicle remains free of collisions at all future times. We introduce the concept of policy recoverability to characterize whether a vehicle can safely return to the original policy's feasible set in finite time. Our method identifies states that are unsafe in the long term under the original policy but recoverable, and selectively edits policy outputs within this region. The vehicle corrects its actions upon entering this region and resumes the original policy upon recovery. Closed-loop simulations on nuPlan urban driving scenarios show a 48% reduction in safety incidents under the original policy while largely preserving its driving performance.

translated_title: 面向自动驾驶闭环安全性的可恢复性策略编辑
translated_abstract: 基于神经网络模型驱动的自动驾驶缺乏安全性保证。我们提出了一种状态级的策略编辑技术，在可恢复的扰动下保证闭环安全性，同时复用模型现有的驾驶能力。闭环安全是指车辆在所有未来时刻都保持无碰撞状态。我们引入了策略可恢复性的概念，用于表征车辆能否在有限时间内安全地返回到原始策略的可行集。我们的方法识别出在原始策略下长期不安全但可恢复的状态，并在该区域内选择性地编辑策略输出。车辆在进入该区域时会纠正其动作，并在恢复后重新执行原始策略。在nuPlan城市驾驶场景上的闭环仿真实验显示，与原始策略相比，安全事故减少了48%，同时在很大程度上保留了其驾驶性能。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种状态级策略编辑技术，通过引入策略可恢复性概念，在不改变模型原有驾驶能力的前提下，保证自动驾驶在可恢复扰动下的闭环安全性，在nuPlan场景中将安全事故减少了48%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a state-level policy editing technique that introduces the concept of policy recoverability to guarantee closed-loop safety in autonomous driving under recoverable disturbances while reusing the model's existing driving capabilities, reducing safety incidents by 48% on nuPlan scenarios.
